name: WorldMuseum
description: World Museum — An editorial deep-time timeline and 2026 World Atlas inspired by the Apple Macintosh Museum. Seamless scrub navigation, dynamic 1600px Wikimedia archives, and subtle era-shifting themes built in React.

paragraphs: World Museum is an immersive, full-screen web experience exploring 4.54 billion years of Earth's planetary and biological history — from the formation of the early Earth through the evolution of life, human civilization, and space exploration — before arriving at a contemporary 2026 World Atlas.
The project combines an editorial museum interface, chronological exhibit navigation, curated stories, image-rich exploration, and regional destination guides in a single React application.

Project status: World Museum is an interactive front-end project. Build and test commands should be run against the current checkout, and scientific claims, image licenses, accessibility, and real-world destination information should be reviewed before production use.
